identityRule: Guid(SHA256(UTF8("cent-curriculum-v1:" + prefixed_key))[0..16]); first GUID fields use .NET little-endian layout
notes: CreatedAt and ImportedAt are runtime metadata, not bundled fields, and are excluded from expected-value comparisons.
Database-only trainings/documents are preserved as additional development content.
Source exercise Difficulty and FigureSvg are present in the bundle but are not fields on CentSourceExercise; these values are preserved in bundled/curriculum.json.
OriginalHtml is compared separately against exact bundled HTML bytes decoded as UTF-8.
